safe_next_batch_increment.basis: Difference between proposed covered verified subtotal and the SHA-bound current checkpoint subtotal; not a repeat of all outputs since baseline38.
safe_next_batch_increment.acceptance_note: 87 pilot acceptances already in formal current index; root-signed but uninstalled batches are excluded.
safe_next_batch_increment.candidate_downloaded_note: pending; queue/source aliases or derivative files do not establish formal new originals
safe_next_batch_increment.apply_condition: Apply only if the current checkpoint SHA256 equals based_on_checkpoint_sha256 and apply_allowed=true. Install the proposed covered subtotal, never add coverage_since_baseline again. Global actual/coordinator counts stay null.
safe_next_batch_increment.coverage: baseline38 plus listed P1/P2 snapshot only; not complete global tool census

single_generation_acceptance.definition: one tool output per accepted configuration, allowing deterministic cleanup/padding; not raw visual first-draft pass rate

summary.raw_visual_first_draft_pass_rate_reason: not uniformly recorded; post-cleanup acceptance is not evidence of raw visual pass

throughput.definition: both workers combined, wall time includes waiting/review; snapshot rate, not steady-state forecast

summary.raw_technical_first_draft_pass_rate_reas: Uniform explicit raw alpha/canvas technical pass judgments are not recorded. Final SHA differing from raw means a derivative was accepted, not proof that the raw failed every technical check.
summary.visual_vs_technical_basis: First-generation visual pass, raw alpha/padding technical pass, one-generation acceptance, and unmodified-output acceptance are separate metrics. Missing raw judgments remain unknown.
